book.name: MATTHEW
book.title: Id ash d Matthew Oꞌohana ab Amjed g Jiosh Alidag

content: Mattsh pi wo t‑chehgidam matt haschu s‑apꞌekam hab wo juh

Kush hab ep kaij g Jesus, “Am g wo s‑e nenꞌoidad mamt pi am hu hab wabsh wo wuad g haꞌichu s‑apꞌekam hab ahgk mat g hemajkam wo neidad mam haschu am hab junihim. Jiosh at pi ab hu wo em‑mah g s‑kehg mahkigdag mamtp hab masma wabsh wo s‑e chehgidam.

“Pi g wo s‑e chehgidamk mamt hekid wo i ha wehmt g shoꞌigkam. Hegam mo s‑e chehgidamk mo i ha wehmt o am hab wua em‑namki ed ch an kahya ch ed. K g hemajkam ab si has ha elid. Neh, id o d ha‑namkidadag. Nt wo si shel em‑ahgi mat g Jiosh pi ab hu has wo ha el.
Ahpim amt wabsh s‑aꞌagi wo i ha wehmtad g shoꞌigkam mat pi hedai wo s‑mahchk.
T g em‑ohg Jiosh wo em‑neid k ab wo si has em‑elidad.
Hoꞌigeꞌidahuna mashchamadag

“Pi g wo s‑e chehgidamk mamt hekid wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahu. Hegam mo s‑e chehgidamk at wo gegokiwua k wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahu am em‑namki ed ch an kahya ch ed. Kut wehsijj wo ha neid k ab wo si has ha elidad. Neh, id o d ha namkidadag. Nt wo si shel em‑ahgi mat g Jiosh pi ab hu has wo ha elidad.
Ahpim amt am wo i wahp e‑kih ed k ab wo si i kuh g kihjeg k am wabsh hejelko wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahu Jiosh wui. Kut heg wo waꞌi em‑neidad ch ab wo has em‑elidad.
“Hegam mo pi mahch g Jiosh o am wabsh muꞌikko e dahm hab haꞌichu chechꞌe hab elidch mat hab waꞌi masma wo ha kah g Jiosh. Mt wabshaba ahpim pi hab masma hab wo e junihid.
Jiosh o d em‑ohg ch heki hu s‑mahch mam haschu i tatchua mam wa chum koi ab hu tahni haꞌichu.
Bamt masma am wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahunad:

content.text: T‑ohg Jiosh, an ap kihdag dahm kahchim ch ed.
Kuch ab si has m‑elid ch si haꞌichuchud g m‑chehgig.
Ab ach m‑tahni mapt wo i geꞌedaj g e‑kownaltalig ia t‑shahgid mat g m‑tatchui am hab wo e junihid ia jewed dahm hab masma mo an hab e wua m‑kihdag ed.
Ab g i s‑t‑hoꞌigeꞌid k ab wo t‑mahkad g haꞌichu hugi wehs tashkaj.
Gam g hu hab i juhni g pi ap t‑chuꞌijig hab masma mach gam hu pi chechegitod g ha‑chuꞌijig hegam mat hedai pi ap has chuꞌi ab t‑wui.
Pi g am hiwgid g Jiawul mas am wo t‑shul pi apꞌekam ch ed.
[Ahpi ap d kownal wehs haꞌichu dahm ch wehs edgid g gewkdag.
Kutt ab wo si has m‑elidad chum hekid.]

content: Neh, bamt masma am wo e hoꞌigeꞌidahunad Jiosh wui wabsh pi chegitok g pi ap ha‑chuꞌijig. T g Jiosh gam hu hab wo i juh g pi ap em‑chuꞌijig.
T wabshaba g em‑chuꞌijig pi gam hab wo i e juh mamtp pi wo pi chegito g ha‑chuꞌijig.
Mamtsh hebaichujj wo dagito g e‑gegosig mamt wo si e hoꞌigeꞌidahu

“Pi g wo s‑e chehgidamk mam pi ap e tahtk mamt hekid heꞌekkio pi wo e gegos e hoꞌigeꞌidahunch. Hegam mat wo s‑e chehgidam at wo nei g e‑namkidadag mat g hemajkam ab wo si has ha el. Nt wabshaba wo si shel em‑ahgi mat g Jiosh pi ab hu has wo ha el.
Am g wo wakon g e‑wuhiosha k ab wo si i gaswua g e‑moꞌo.
T hab pi wo mahchk g hemajkam ab i em‑neidk mam pi e gegosid. T heg wo waꞌi s‑mahchk em‑ohg Jiosh ch ab wo si has em‑elidad.
T‑kaisdag an Jiosh kihdag ed
“Pi g an hu wo e toꞌidahid g s‑kaisdag id dahm jewed. Tp hems wabsh wo padt o atp hems hema wo em‑ehs.
Mt wabshaba wo hekaj g e‑kaisdag am Jiosh wehhejed. T heg wo wa wepok mam heg an e toꞌidahim Jiosh kihdag ed. T pi hekid wo padt. Kut pi hedai wo em‑ehs.
Kumt am wo s‑hihimim no pi g em‑tatchuidag am ulinig mo hebai haꞌichug mam haschu hab i elid mo d em‑kaisdag.
Mash t‑tonlidch g t‑amichudadag
“Em‑wuhpui at s‑ap am wo i wahki g tonlig matp wo s‑mamsk

k wabshaba pi am hu wo i wahki matp pi wo mamsk. Kum heg hekaj s‑ap nuhkud. Pegih, wahm amt wo si s‑ap nuhkudad g haꞌichu e‑amichudadag mat heg s‑ap am wo i wahki g wohokam. Dat wo si geꞌe s‑chuhugamk em‑wehhejed matp pi wo apꞌek g em‑amichudadag.
Matt pi ab hu haꞌichu t‑eniga ab wo si pihk t‑elidad

“Pi at hedai wo e nako mas ha wepo hab masma ab wo ha neidad g gohk e‑aꞌamo. Hemho wa atp hems hema baꞌich wo i s‑wohog elidad. Em‑kaisdag o heg wa wepo mo d em‑ahmo mamtp heg hekaj baꞌich wo i pihk e elidad mam hi g Jiosh.

“Neh, nt heg hekaj hab wo em‑ah mamt pi wabsh wo i e kudutad heg hekaj mams haschukaj wo e gegos o mams haschukaj wo e enigadad. Jiosh at ab em‑mah g em‑doakag, pegih, k ab hab waꞌap wo em‑mah mamt haschukaj wo e dagioꞌidad.

An g wo i ha neid hegam uꞌuwhig mo an nenꞌe. Idam o pi haꞌichu eꞌeshad ch pi od g haꞌichu esha ch pi gan hu e toꞌidahim g haꞌichu bahidag. K wabshaba g em‑ohg Jiosh ha nuhkud. Kum eda ahpim baꞌich d i si haꞌichu mo g uꞌuwhig.
Pi amt wo e nako mams am baꞌich wo i himch g e‑aꞌahidagga, chum ams hems wo si e kudutad am chegitokch.
“Pi g am wo si e kudutad ab amjed mams haschu ab wo enigat. An g wo i neidad g haꞌichu heosig m an wehsko chuhch. Heg o wa wepo mo si s‑kehg e enigadadch ch eda pi haꞌichu shaꞌi shohshom.
Solomonbad o pi hab masma s‑kehg e enigadadch, chum as d si s‑kais kownal.

Neh, haꞌichu wuhshanig o wabsh al heꞌekia tash an hab chuꞌig. K eda g Jiosh si s‑kehg an wuhshad. Kum ahpim baꞌich d i haꞌichu am wehhejed. Kut woho ab wo em‑enigadad. Pegih, mt heg hekaj ab wabsh wo si hiwgad
ch pi am hu wo e kudutad ab amjed mams hebai wo bei g e‑gegosig o g e‑wehschuga.
Hegam mo pi mahch g Jiosh o id am wa si oid. M eda ahpim d Jiosh aꞌaliga. K heg s‑mahch mam tatchua wehs ihda.
Wehpeg g am wo i e dagitok Jiosh wui k hab d wo s‑apꞌekamk. Kut heg wehs ab wo i em‑mah mam haschu i tatchua.
“Pi g am wo shaꞌi e kudutad heg amjed mat haschu has wo i e juh baꞌich tash. Am o wa haꞌichug g em‑kudutadag id i tashkaj ch pi hab chum mahs mams g siꞌalim kudutadag ab wo i wehnad.
